backups.pageDescription: Manage torrent backups for your instances

noInstances.heading: Connect a qBittorrent instance
noInstances.message: No qBittorrent instances configured. Add an instance first to use the backup feature.

checkingCompatibility.heading: Checking instance compatibility
checkingCompatibility.message: Checking which instances support torrent backups.

selectInstancePrompt.heading: Select an instance to manage backups
selectInstancePrompt.message: Choose a qBittorrent instance from the dropdown above to view and manage its backups.

noCompatible.heading: No compatible instances found
noCompatible.message: None of your qBittorrent instances support torrent backups yet. Upgrade to qBittorrent 4.5.0+ (Web API 2.8.11+) to enable this feature.

unavailable.title: Backups unavailable for this instance
unavailable.description: qBittorrent Web API 2.8.11+ (qBittorrent 4.5.0+) is required to export .torrent files for backups. This instance reports {{version}}, so torrent exports are disabled.

settings.title: Backup settings
settings.enableBackupsDescription: Turn on automatic backups for this instance. Pick at least one cadence below; leave this off for manual-only backups.
settings.includeCategoriesDescription: Group torrents inside the archive by their category
settings.includeTagsDescription: Store torrent tags in the manifest
settings.automaticCadencesDescription: Hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly runs start after the previous backup finishes and their interval has elapsed. Leave them all off if you only trigger backups manually.
settings.keepHourlyDescription: How many hourly snapshots to keep before older ones are pruned.
settings.keepDailyDescription: How many daily snapshots to keep before rotation.
settings.keepWeeklyDescription: How many weekly snapshots to keep before rotation.
settings.keepMonthlyDescription: How many monthly snapshots to keep before rotation.
settings.hourlyTooltip: Runs roughly once per hour when backups are enabled and at least an hour has passed since the last run.
settings.dailyTooltip: Runs about once every 24 hours after the previous job finishes.
settings.weeklyTooltip: Runs once the last backup is at least seven days old.
settings.monthlyTooltip: Runs when the previous run is from an earlier calendar month.

validation.selectCadence: Select at least one cadence (hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly) before saving.
validation.changesApply: Changes apply to future backups as soon as you save.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.incrementalDescription: Adds missing categories, tags, and torrents without touching existing data.
restore.overwriteDescription: Adds missing items and updates existing categories/torrents to match the snapshot.
restore.completeDescription: Same as overwrite, then removes anything not recorded in the backup.
restore.autoResumeTooltip: When enabled, torrents resume automatically if qBittorrent reports the restored data as fully checked. In other words; no data is missing.
restore.autoResumeOnInfo: Torrents will resume automatically once qBittorrent reports the restored data as fully checked.
restore.autoResumeOffInfo: Auto resume is off. Torrents stay paused until you start them manually.
restore.skipRecheckInfo: Enable skip recheck to allow automatic resume after verification.
restore.noChangesRequired: No changes are required for this restore mode.

schedule.automaticBackupsOff: Automatic backups are turned off for this instance.
schedule.enableCadence: Enable at least one automatic cadence to schedule backups.
schedule.backupQueued: Backup is queued and will start shortly.
schedule.waitingScheduler: Waiting for the scheduler to pick up the next backup.
schedule.waitingFirstBackup: Waiting for the first backup; scheduler will run ASAP.
schedule.overdueRetry: Should have already run; scheduler will retry automatically.
